purposes.applies_to: Narayana dasa and other phalita dasas
purposes.name: Phalita dasas
purposes.rule_2_planets: Jupiter, Mercury and the rasi's lord

purposes.applies_to: Atmakaraka kendradi graha and rasi dasas
purposes.name: Dasas based on the Atma Karaka
purposes.note: The sign containing AK is stronger than any other rasi. After the Mercury/Jupiter/lord check, a rasi whose lord is in a quadrant from AK beats one whose lord is in a panaphara from AK.
purposes.rule_2_planets: Jupiter, Mercury and the rasi's lord

purposes.name: Ayur dasas
purposes.note: "Aspect of all other planets is equally important" does not say how to weigh them against the luminaries, so rule 2 cannot be computed for this purpose from the text alone.
purposes.rule_2_planets: the luminaries; aspect of all other planets is equally important; there is no significance for the aspect of lord

body.warning: The above rules are too general. One should understand the meaning of each rule and adapt based on the situation.
